column1: # A random sample of 900 suggestions for words with 3+ meanings, each judged ok or wrong.
# Wrong ones are removed through relations.tsv.

column3: note
self-respecting means dignified, not pleased with an achievement
lessen does not mean make less dense
resist is not breaking a law
unusual does not mean excessive
invest does not mean arrange in advance
fun does not substitute for a thrill or kick
expanded does not mean long
process is not a round of duties
unmarred applies to objects, not unhurt people
stuff does not mean overwhelm
fault is not a mark on a reputation
stuffy means prim, not cool and detached
stake is the money risked, not the venture
drift is not a series of occurrences
excitement is a cause, not a reddening of the face
back is not the tail or rear
scintilla means a tiny trace, not a flash of light
twaddle means nonsense, not gossip
once does not mean gone by
shape is not an empty outer structure
evidence (verb) cannot replace look as in seem
conversion is a specific score type, not scoring in general
accompanying cannot replace the adverb along
smothered does not mean dull
sever means cut off, not slice thin
stratum is a layer, not a height
grounded does not mean competent
impudent means rude, not gently teasing
possession is having, not taking by force
persist is intransitive and cannot replace sustain
lean is not lying flat
rosette is a decoration, not a tied fastening
keyed up means tense, not willing
affront is an insult, not a stinging pain
stipulation is a condition, not a promise
loiter means linger, not postpone
necessities are not a means of earning a living
crescent is a curved street, not an open public area
stare is long, not a brief look
baffling means puzzling, not indistinct
substitution is not portrayal
sympathies is not the seat of feelings
genus is a taxonomic term, reads oddly for kind
meager means scanty, not slight of build
digress is to stray in speech, not turn
pioneer is an innovator, not a model for copies
go on about means talk at length, not leak secrets
warranty is a guarantee, not pledged property
break is not becoming stuck
accompany means go with someone, not carry
invincible means unbeatable, not hardy
performance is not a generic happening
promenade is a leisurely stroll, not a measured march
in for a penny is an idiom fragment, not a substitute
restore does not mean send money owed
pyramid does not mean prosper
abandon does not mean cushion or lessen force
indolence is laziness, not a slack period
shining does not substitute for lightness as brightness
amorous means sexually loving, not hearty
rub does not mean handle roughly
promote is transitive; develop here is intransitive
list does not mean sort into groups
gross does not mean voracious
appeal is a plea, the opposite of peremptory
itinerary is a plan of a route, not a journey
abundant means plentiful, not generous
idol is an image or object of worship, not a god
paragon is a model of excellence, not a template
impose needs on and does not mean strain
shaky does not mean senseless
gray does not mean worn or decayed
color does not mean give a taste
menial is a servant, not an adult man
blockade is not an order forbidding something
slant is not to swerve
deride means mock scornfully, not jest
cage is not a roost
slit is a long cut, not a pierced hole
expelled is permanent, not temporary suspension
crumbling is not stale
retreat means withdraw, not come back
vitiated means impaired or invalidated, not worn out
effective does not mean thoroughgoing
deflect is transitive and means turn something aside
protuberance is a bump, not a fastening peg
position is not reputation
beam does not mean fill with light
goblet has no handle, not a mug
amiable means friendly, not welcome
oppose is not breaking a law
insert is transitive, cannot replace enter a place
exacting means demanding, not affected
age does not mean draw to an end
separate does not mean enclose with a fence
fan is a follower, not one who does it for pleasure
prompt means urge, not convey indirectly
rentable does not mean unoccupied
chance does not mean stake money on
alienate means estrange, not form a boundary
expend does not fit passing time
besmirch means sully, not put to base use
dividend is investment return, not wages
efficient does not mean highly skilled
react to does not mean confirm receipt
solicitors are not the bar
constrict means squeeze, not cut short
escape hatch is for people, not an air vent
previous means earlier, not first of all
occupant is not a subject of a ruler
diagram is not an outline edge
drain does not mean shake confidence
incarceration is imprisonment, not the seizing
ambition is not firmness of purpose
compose does not mean make up a quarrel
under the weather means ill, not drunk
guard does not escort people to seats
fit means healthy, not neat and groomed
impose does not mean command attention or respect
quiver is a tremble, not a jolt
blueprint is a plan, not a mould
relic is an object from the past, not a trace
swat is a hard hit, not a light touch
talent is ability, not one's interest
acceleration is speeding up, not progress
punch is a fist blow, not a shove
propulsion is not a head butt
damp means slightly wet, not free-flowing
anticipate means expect, not intend
insult is not a stinging pain
